verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal is an in-person payments and POS hardware/SDK product, not an AI agent or assistant host. Acting as an MCP client that loads tools from other servers is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence documents only Stripe's own MCP server, which serves tools to other agents. That is the opposite (server) role and does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
